src: F&O ka matlab hai Futures aur Options. Ye derivatives hain, yaani inki keemat kisi aur cheez (share ya index) ki chaal se banti hai.
Share kharidne par tum company ka hissa lete ho. F&O mein tum sirf ek contract lete ho ki bhaav upar jayega ya neeche.
Futures mein dono taraf ki zimmedari hoti hai. Options mein kharidne wale ko haq milta hai, zimmedari nahi. Isliye options kharidne wale ka nuksaan seemit hota hai.
F&O fixed lot size mein hota hai, jaise ek lot mein 75 quantity. Isliye ek chhoti si chaal bhi paise ko tezi se badal sakti hai.
Yaad rakho: F&O mein bahut log paisa ganwate hain. Hum yahan seekhne aaye hain, jaldi ameer hone nahi.
Call option: ek tay keemat (strike) par kharidne ka haq, zimmedari nahi. Bazaar upar jaye to call ka bhaav badhta hai.
Put option: ek tay keemat par bechne ka haq. Bazaar neeche jaye to put ka bhaav badhta hai.
Example: Nifty 25,800 par hai. 25,800 CE kharida aur Nifty 25,900 gaya, to call ka bhaav badhega. 25,800 PE kharida aur Nifty 25,700 gaya, to put ka bhaav badhega.
Sirf disha sahi hona kaafi nahi. Chaal tay samay ke andar aur kaafi badi honi chahiye, warna premium ghat sakta hai.
Yaad rakho: CE matlab call, PE matlab put. Kharidne wala maximum premium hi ganwa sakta hai.
Nifty 50 aur Sensex bade shares ke index hain. Bank Nifty sirf bade banks ka index hai, isliye zyada tezi se hilta hai.
Index options cash-settled hote hain: expiry par share nahi milte, sirf faida ya nuksaan paise mein aata hai.
Lot size ek contract ki quantity hai. App mein demo lot Nifty 75, Bank Nifty 30, Sensex 20 hain. Asli lot size exchange badalta rehta hai, broker mein check karo.
Ek lot ki keemat = premium x lot size. Premium 100 aur lot 75 ho to ek lot ₹7,500 ka hua.
Yaad rakho: trade se pehle hamesha lot size aur lagne wala paisa check karo.
Premium wo keemat hai jo tum option kharidne ke liye dete ho. Ye bazaar mein roz upar neeche hoti hai.
Strike wo level hai jis par contract bana hai. Jo strike bhaav ke sabse paas ho wo ATM hai.
Call mein bhaav se neeche ki strike ITM aur upar ki OTM hai. Put mein ulta: upar ki strike ITM, neeche ki OTM. OTM sasta hota hai par chalne ke chance kam.
Premium = intrinsic value + time value. Time value expiry ke paas ghatti jati hai, aur expiry par OTM option aam taur par zero ke paas hota hai.
Yaad rakho: sasta premium matlab kam chance. Kam daam mein zyada kamai ki guarantee nahi.
Option kharidne wale (buyer) ka nuksaan sirf diya hua premium. Faida bahut bada ho sakta hai.
Option bechne wale (seller) ko premium turant milta hai, par bhaav ulta chale to nuksaan bahut bada ho sakta hai. Naked call mein upar koi seema nahi.
Seller ko margin (zamanat) rakhna padta hai. Isliye bechne ke liye zyada paisa chahiye.
Selling mein jeet ka percent aksar zyada dikhta hai, par ek bada nuksaan kai chhoti jeeton ko khatam kar sakta hai.
Yaad rakho: win rate ke saath har trade ka average faida aur nuksaan bhi dekho.
Live chart mein price har second badalta hai. Tez chaal ke baad aksar thoda rukna ya palatna dekha jata hai.
Candle ek time period ka open, high, low, close dikhati hai. Lambi candle tezi, chhoti candle rukawat batati hai.
VWAP volume ke hisaab se din bhar ka average bhaav hai. Bhaav VWAP ke upar tike to kharidar mazboot maane jaate hain.
Bhaav VWAP ke neeche tike to bechne wale mazboot maane jaate hain. Ye sanket hai, guarantee nahi.
Ab Live tab mein dekho. Wahan pehle sirf price, VWAP aur buy/sell dabav ko dekhna seekho.
Option chain mein har strike ka call aur put dikhta hai: premium, volume aur OI.
OI (Open Interest) abhi khule hue contracts ki ginti hai. Volume us din hue sauda hain, OI ab bhi bache hue sauda.
Jis strike par call OI sabse zyada, wahan resistance (upar rukawat) maana jata hai. Jahan put OI sabse zyada, wahan support.
Ye isliye kyunki option sellers wahan apna level bachane ki koshish karte hain. Par level toot bhi jate hain.
Ab Mood tab mein dekho. Wahan support aur resistance khud dhoondo. OI sanket hai, guarantee nahi.
PCR = Put OI ÷ Call OI. 1 ke aas paas neutral maana jata hai.
PCR 1.2 se upar: put OI zyada, support mazboot dikhta hai. 0.8 se neeche: call OI zyada, resistance bhari.
Bahut zyada PCR ka matlab ye bhi ho sakta hai ki bazaar ek taraf bahut jhuk gaya hai aur palat sakta hai.
PCR akela nahi dekhte. Bhaav, VWAP aur OI ke saath milakar dekho.
Yaad rakho: koi bhi ek indicator bazaar ko poora nahi samjhata.
VIX bazaar ki ghabrahat naapta hai. VIX upar ho to bade utaar-chadhaav ki ummeed aur option mehnge.
Mota hisaab: aaj ka 1 sigma range = Spot x VIX ÷ 100 ÷ √252. Ye Mood tab mein dikhta hai.
Bhaav is range ke andar lagbhag 68% samay rehta hai, yaani 32% baar bahar bhi jata hai.
Jab VIX upar ho to option kharidna mehnga aur bechna zyada premium wala hota hai, par risk bhi bada hota hai.
Yaad rakho: range andaza hai, deewar nahi.
Max pain wo strike hai jahan option sellers ko kul sabse kam payout karna padta hai.
Expiry ke din bhaav aksar uske aas paas ghoomta dikhta hai, par hamesha nahi.
Expiry par premium bahut tezi se ghatta hai (theta). OTM option kai baar kuch minute mein zero ke paas pahunch jata hai.
Expiry ke din chaal tez aur ulti-seedhi ho sakti hai. Shuruat mein expiry ke din trade avoid karna samajhdari hai.
Yaad rakho: expiry kisi ke liye mauka hai, kisi ke liye jaal. Pehle seekho, phir socho.
Range breakout: shuru ke minutes ki sabse upar ya neeche ki line toote to chaal banne ki ummeed. Par jhoote breakout kaafi hote hain.
Momentum burst: kuch second mein tez ek-tarfa chaal. Der se ghusne par bhaav palat sakta hai.
Har setup ke saath stop-loss pehle se tay hota hai. Bina stop-loss ke setup lena jua hai.
Ab Scorecard tab mein dekho. Wahan har setup ka pichle 100 ka record hai. Buying aur selling dono side ki jeet dekho.
Yaad rakho: setup sanket hai. Kai setups lagatar fail bhi hote hain.
VWAP reclaim: bhaav VWAP ko paar karke wahin tik jaye. Chhoo kar laut aaye to wo sanket nahi.
OI long buildup: bhaav badhe aur OI bhi badhe, yaani naye kharidar aa rahe hain.
OI short buildup: bhaav gire aur OI badhe, yaani naye bechne wale aa rahe hain.
Bhaav badhe par OI ghate to purane sauda kat rahe hain (short covering), chaal kamzor ho sakti hai.
Yaad rakho: OI ko bhaav ke saath jodkar padho, akela OI adhura hai.
'Pichle 100 mein 60 jeete' ka matlab aage bhi 60% nahi hota. Ye sirf purana average hai.
Expectancy = (jeet% x average faida) − (haar% x average nuksaan). Sirf positive expectancy wala tareeka tikta hai.
60% jeet bhi ghate mein ja sakti hai agar haar jeet se badi ho. 40% jeet bhi kamai de sakti hai agar jeet haar se kaafi badi ho.
Kam trade ka sample bharosemand nahi. 100 se zyada trade aur alag-alag bazaar halat mein dekhna chahiye.
Yaad rakho: aankde disha dete hain, bharosa nahi.
Ek trade mein kul poonji ka 1 se 2% se zyada jokhim mat lo. Tab lagatar 10 haar bhi tumhe khatam nahi karengi.
Stop-loss trade lene se pehle tay hota hai. Use hatana ya door khiskana sabse badi galtiyon mein se ek hai.
Lots = Risk rupaye ÷ ((entry − stop-loss) x lot size). Risk tab mein ye khud nikalta hai.
Target 1 chhoone par stop-loss entry par le aao, taki jeeta hua trade haar na bane.
Ab Risk tab dekho. Yaad rakho: pehle nuksaan ki seema tay karo, phir munafe ki baat karo.
Ab paper wallet khulega: ₹5,00,000 virtual paisa, asli nahi. Yahan galtiyan sasti hain, isliye yahin seekho.
Setup card se 'Paper trade lo' dabao. Stop-loss, target 1 aur target 2 app khud pakadta hai.
Har trade par lagbhag ₹60 charges aur 0.5% slippage judta hai, taki result asli ke kareeb rahe.
Din ki loss limit (default 4%) poori ho to naye trade lock ho jaate hain. Ye aadat asli khate ko bachati hai.
Ab Paper tab mein jao. Yaad rakho: paper mein bhi plan ke hisaab se chalo, jaise paisa asli ho.
Option ka premium samay ke saath ghatta hai, ise theta kehte hain. Expiry ke paas ye aur tez hota hai.
Isliye kharidne wale ko sirf disha nahi, samay bhi sahi chahiye. Bhaav der se chala to premium kha jata hai.
Shuruat mein bahut OTM option mat kharido. Wo sasta lagta hai par zyadatar zero hota hai.
Kharidne ke baad jitni der rukte ho, utna theta kharch hota hai. Plan mein time limit bhi rakho.
Yaad rakho: theta kharidne wale ka dushman aur bechne wale ka dost hai.
Delta: bhaav 1 point badhne par premium kitna badhega. ATM option ka delta lagbhag 0.5 hota hai.
Gamma: delta kitni tezi se badalta hai. Expiry ke paas gamma bada hota hai, isliye chaal tez hoti hai.
Vega: volatility (IV) badhne par premium kitna badhega. IV girne par premium sasta ho jata hai, chahe bhaav na hile.
Theta samay ka asar hai. Kharidne wale par theta ka, bechne wale par gamma ka khatra zyada rehta hai.
Yaad rakho: premium sirf bhaav se nahi, samay aur volatility se bhi badalta hai.
Revenge trade: haar ke turant baad badla lene wala trade. Ye sabse mehnga trade hota hai.
Overtrading: din mein bahut saare trade. Zyada trade ka matlab zyada charges aur zyada galtiyan.
FOMO: chhut jane ke dar se liya hua trade. Chhooti hui chaal ke peeche mat bhaago, agla setup aayega.
Har trade ke baad likho: kyun liya, plan ke hisaab se nikla ya nahi. Paper tab ka journal yahi hai.
Yaad rakho: bazaar ko harana nahi hai, apni aadatein sudharni hain.
RBI, budget, global bazaar, nateeje aur geopolitics gap aur tez chaal laate hain.
Khabar ke turant baad spread aur slippage badh jata hai, yaani entry aur exit mehnga padta hai.
Gap-up ya gap-down: bazaar pichle close se door khulta hai. Gap ke baad pehle 15 minute chaal aksar unsthir rehti hai.
Khabar sunte hi trade mat lo. Pehle dekho ki chaal tikti hai ya nahi.
Yaad rakho: khabar ke baad pehla jhatka aksar bheed ko fasa deta hai.
BTST (aaj kharido, kal becho): raat ke gap ka risk. Gap tumhare khilaf bhi ja sakta hai aur stop-loss ko paar kar sakta hai.
Zero-hero: bahut sasta OTM option, jo zyadatar zero par khatam hota hai aur kabhi kabhar kai guna deta hai.
Ye dono lottery jaise khel hain. Sirf utna paisa lagao jo ganwana manzoor ho.
Zero-hero ke liye alag chhota budget rakho aur use apni mukhya poonji se alag maano.
Ab Ideas tab dekho. Yaad rakho: kabhi kabhar kai guna milne se roz roz ka nuksaan nahi dhulta.
Option bechne par tumhe premium turant milta hai. Agar option expiry par OTM rahe to wo premium tumhara munafa hai.
Seller ka maximum faida sirf premium hota hai. Nuksaan kai guna ho sakta hai.
Isliye seller aksar sahi hota hai par kabhi kabhi bahut bada galat. Ye seedhi chadhne aur lift se girne jaisa hai.
Selling ka faida: theta tumhare saath. Khatra: achanak badi chaal (gap, khabar) aur margin call.
Yaad rakho: selling chhoti jeet ka khel hai jisme ek badi haar sab kha sakti hai.

lessons.t: Margin aur naked selling ka khatra
src: Naked selling: bina kisi suraksha ke option bechna. Margin bahut lagta hai, ek lot par lakhon mein.
Naked call bechne par bhaav bahut badhe to nuksaan bahut bada ho sakta hai, jiski koi upari seema nahi.
Margin ka matlab broker tumhari poonji rokta hai. Bhaav ulta chale to extra margin dena padta hai, warna broker position kaat deta hai.
Naked selling shuruat karne walon ke liye nahi hai. Hum ise sirf samajhne ke liye padh rahe hain, trade ke liye nahi.
Yaad rakho: bina hedge ke selling aag se khelna hai.
Hedge ka matlab: ek position ke saath doosri suraksha wali position. Bechne wale option ke saath door ka option kharidna.
Bull put spread: ek put becho aur usse neeche ki strike ka put kharido. Bazaar ruka rahe ya badhe to faida.
Bear call spread: ek call becho aur usse upar ki strike ka call kharido. Bazaar ruka rahe ya gire to faida.
Max faida = mila hua net premium. Max nuksaan = strike ka antar − net premium. Dono pehle se pata hote hain.
Yaad rakho: hedge se kamai kam hoti hai par nuksaan ki seema tay ho jati hai.
Short strangle: ek OTM call aur ek OTM put dono bechna. Dono taraf bada risk, isliye ye unhedged hai.
Iron condor: strangle ke saath dono taraf door ke call aur put kharidna. Isse dono taraf ka risk tay ho jata hai.
Iron condor tab theek jab bazaar range mein rehne ki ummeed ho. Bada trend ya gap aaye to nuksaan seemit par poora ho sakta hai.
Max nuksaan = ek taraf ki wing width − kul mila premium. Wings jitni door, risk utna zyada par premium kam.
Yaad rakho: iron condor paisa chhaapne ki machine nahi, tay risk wala trade hai.
Selling mein bhi stop-loss zaroori hai: jaise mile premium ka 1.5 ya 2 guna nuksaan hone par nikalna.
Adjustment: bhaav ek taraf bhaage to us taraf ka hissa kaatna ya door ki strike le jana. Isse nuksaan badh bhi sakta hai, bina seekhe mat karo.
Kabhi kabhi sabse achha adjustment hai nikal jana. Haare hue trade ko 'theek ho jayega' soch kar mat rakho.
Har selling trade ka plan pehle likho: entry, hedge, stop-loss, aur kab nikalna hai.
Yaad rakho: bechne wale ko pehle bachna seekhna hai, kamana baad mein.
Expiry ke din premium bahut tezi se girta hai, isliye selling aakarshak lagti hai.
Par gamma bada hone se chhoti chaal par bhi option ka bhaav bahut tezi se badalta hai. Kuch minute mein bada nuksaan ho sakta hai.
Expiry din ke gap aur news spike mein seller ka stop-loss slippage ke saath paar ho jata hai.
Shuruati sellers ke liye behtar hai ki expiry din chhoti size ya sirf hedged position rakhein, ya na rakhein.
Yaad rakho: jahan premium sabse mota dikhe, wahan risk bhi sabse bada hota hai.
Selling mein bhi ek trade mein kul poonji ka 1 se 2% jokhim, aur hedge ke saath hi.
Margin ka sirf 40 se 50% ke aas paas istemal karo, baaki buffer rakho taki achanak chaal mein margin call na aaye.
Ek hi disha mein kai sauda mat rakho. Sab kuch ek expiry aur ek index par lagana concentration risk hai.
Roz ki loss limit seller par bhi lagu hoti hai. Limit lage to us din band.
Yaad rakho: seller ki umra uski suraksha se naapi jaati hai, kamai se nahi.
Raat ko tay karo: gap-up, gap-down aur flat khulne par tum kya karoge. Ye bhavishyavani nahi, taiyari hai.
Support, resistance aur max pain ke levels likh lo. Subah unhe dekh kar hi faisla lo.
Pehle 15 minute dekhne ke baad hi trade lo, jab tak koi saaf plan na ho.
Roz ek hi routine rakho: raat ko plan, subah levels, trade ke baad journal.
Yaad rakho: jo roz ek hi tareeke se chalta hai, uski galtiyan gin sakte hain aur sudhar sakte hain.
Report card tumhara asli vyavhaar dikhata hai: dhairya, jokhim aur faida ka anupaat, overtrading aur badle ke trade.
Win rate akela mat dekho. Average jeet ÷ average haar bhi dekho, aur sabse badi haar bhi.
Jo score sabse kam ho wahi tumhara agla kaam hai. Ek samay mein ek hi aadat sudharo.
30 se zyada paper trade ke baad hi apni aadat ke baare mein pakka kuch kehna sahi hai.
Yaad rakho: report card sharminda karne ke liye nahi, sudharne ke liye hai.
Positive: seemit jokhim ke saath seekha hua trader bhi bazaar mein tik sakta hai. Hedge aur stop-loss se nuksaan par kaaboo rehta hai.
Negative: zyadatar naye trader F&O mein paisa ganwate hain. Leverage faida aur nuksaan dono ko badhata hai.
Negative: transaction charges, slippage aur tax kamai ko khate hain. Chhota munafa kai baar charges mein hi chala jata hai.
Positive: daily limit, journal aur paper practice se aadatein sudharti hain, aur sudhari hui aadat poonji ki sabse badi suraksha hai.
Yaad rakho: ye course shiksha hai, salah nahi. Asli paise se pehle chhote size se shuru karo, aur sirf wahi paisa lagao jo ganwana manzoor ho.

src: Doji mein open aur close lagbhag same hote hain, body bas ek patli line. Samjho tarazu: khareedar aur bechne wale dono ne zor lagaya, par koi jeeta nahi.
Body candle ki range ke 10% se kam. Range normal se kam se kam aadhi.
Akeli doji par trade nahi banta. Agli candle ka intezaar karo.
Hammer mein neeche lambi shadow aur upar chhoti body hoti hai. Jaise paani mein dabayi gend wapas uchhal aaye: bechne walon ne gira diya, khareedaron ne wapas utha liya.
Neeche ki shadow body se kam se kam 2 guna, upar ki shadow lagbhag nahi. Girawat ke baad bani ho.
Girawat ke baad hi iska matlab hai. Beech trend mein ya sideways bazaar mein bekaar.
